intro: A Houston trio of hypnotic, globe-trotting instrumentals.
story: Khruangbin, a Houston trio whose name means airplane in Thai, makes instrumentals that travel through Thai funk, dub and surf. Con Todo El Mundo came out on Dead Oceans in 2018, and they played Pickathon in 2019. Mordechai followed in 2020, and A LA SALA in 2024 reached the top 40 of the Billboard 200. The Recording Academy nominated them for Best New Artist for the 2025 Grammys.
artist_reel_line: A LA SALA reached the top 40 of the Billboard 200 in 2024.
